<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata/README.md`, `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md`, `packages/spec/PLUGIN_STANDARDS.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via MetadataTypeSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata/README.md`, `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md`, `packages/spec/PLUGIN_STANDARDS.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **169** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0743ee49e8d97693ce74fc6a9b3f3f21d8800c13` — the merge of head `de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f` into base `d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0743ee49e8d97693ce74fc6a9b3f3f21d8800c13 && git checkout 0743ee49e8d97693ce74fc6a9b3f3f21d8800c13
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f && git checkout -B drift-repro d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff && git merge --no-ff de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d4ff1a025fa4568505bfbc66a0f8cbeb3bab06ff` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `93c9b71f0e2794ab58bb647687753937d4ebef10`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md, skills/objectui/README.md, skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md, skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md + packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts (`HookEvent`), packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts (`AggregationFunction`), ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/FormulaFunctions.ts (`registerDefaults`), ui/packages/types/src/base.ts (`ComponentInputControlType`, `ComponentMeta`), ui/packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts (`RegistryComponentMetaExtras`), the `ui/packages/plugin-*` directory listing, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .changeset/27522-inventory-counts.md, .changeset/config.json (`fixed` group), packages/spec/package.json (`files`)

Reviewer: an independent agent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (not the drafter), fed the card, the PR and the check-runs only, adopted by the `domain:skills#1` seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- Governed surface, Tier H (eight `skills/**` paths); draft, no assignee. Face schema + rules ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (the `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` hunk is one `//` comment inside the `MetadataTypeSchema` enum literal: no `.describe()`, no TSDoc, no export moved; nothing to regenerate).
- Skills token ratchet, whole-file `ceil(bytes/4)`: data/SKILL.md 6111→6106, rules/field-types.md 3151→3151, references/data-hooks.md 10066→10064, automation/SKILL.md 6454→6453, query/SKILL.md 4173→4172, objectui/README.md 729→728, schema-expressions.md 6571→6565, plugin-development.md 4184→4183; no file grows. (`rules/field-types.md` is +1 byte, equal tokens — the PR body's "equal bytes" is a nit.)
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, both line-initial in the PR body and the changeset; `patch`.

### ② Semver level

`patch` is right. The frontmatter names only `@objectstack/skills`, while the diff also changes shipped bytes in `@objectstack/spec` (`src/**/*.zod.ts` ships), `@objectstack/metadata`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `plugin-grid`, `components`, `fields`, `types`, `plugin-form`, `console` (READMEs ship). All are in the `fixed` group, so the bump lands anyway; the omission costs their CHANGELOG lines. Should-fix (repo precedent `26080-readme-contributing-links.md`, `26170-translation-data-comment-count.md`).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Deviations (signature-first report line; no PR subscription) answered — no effect on the diff.
- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` was edited on the card's "triage confirms", which triage 6495060086 does not state; AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails mark `content/docs/releases/` RELEASE-OWNED. Escalated to the seat as should-fix.
- Serial constraint with PR #27475 (L181 vs L9): region-disjoint. Answered.

### ④ Design judgment

Per `hits` file, against the cited code on the head: `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` (the deleted "24 lifecycle events" was wrong — `HookEvent` declares eight); automation/SKILL.md (the four node tables are the enumeration); data/SKILL.md (each site still points at its source); data-hooks.md (the table lists exactly the eight `HookEvent` names; "Why so few?" keeps the argument); field-types.md (the tables enumerate); query/SKILL.md (the six names match `AggregationFunction`); objectui/README.md (the 18 names match the 18 `ui/packages/plugin-*` dirs); schema-expressions.md (30 names listed, 30 registered); plugin-development.md L95 (the eleven literals match `ComponentInputControlType`). Each holds: no deleted count carried information the remaining text does not reach; no sentence became false or ungrammatical; no gate-pinned, generated, release-note, ADR or dated site edited in `hits`; deletion only.

Should-fix, same file: `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` L85–87 "Sixteen keys in total: the eleven … plus the five …" — counts of the card's class in an edited `hits` file, neither deleted nor named as kept. A miss against the card's acceptance, not a wrong edit.

Must-fix: none.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md, skills/objectui/README.md, skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md, skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md + packages/spec/src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts (the wire-count pin), ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/readme-locale-count-7989.test.ts and ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts (`BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`, the locale-count pin), .changeset/27522-inventory-counts.md, the nine named packages' package.json `files` lists, ui/packages/types/src/base.ts (`ComponentMeta`, `ComponentInput`), ui/packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts (`RegistryComponentMetaExtras`)

Delta review: `93c9b71f` to `de4e5cca`, two commits (`b5dfb180`, `de4e5cca`), seven files. The first-round record on `93c9b71f` stands for everything the delta does not touch. The merge-base with `origin/main` is unchanged (`aef631b8`). The whole-PR delta vs `main` is now 40 files.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Hits files in the delta: two** (`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`). Both are deletion-only in the ratchet's unit: query/SKILL.md goes from 4172 to 4171 tokens, plugin-development.md from 4183 to 4178, with lines unchanged (403, 482). Right.
- **Governed surface unchanged**: the PR is still Tier H on `skills/**`, still a draft, with no assignee. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on the new head. Right.
- **Two card Inventory rows are gate-pinned**:
  - `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` pins 56 wire codes.
  - `ui/packages/i18n/README.md` pins 10 locales.

  The card's own rule keeps a pinned count, so restoring these two is the right reading of the card. The first head's `Test Core (2/8)` and `Test UI (14/16)` reds were those two pins firing. Nothing else in the first head's red set was this PR's: the Type Check lanes read `cancelled`, which fits the superseding push. Right.
- **`content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` reverted**: `git diff aef631b8 de4e5cca -- content/docs/releases/` is empty. Right.
- **Changeset frontmatter widened to ten packages**; the body gains one sentence naming them, and both declaration lines are unchanged. Right; see ②.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ `patch`, unchanged.

The frontmatter now names ten packages: `@objectstack/skills`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `plugin-grid`, `components`, `fields`, `types`, `plugin-form`, `console`. For each of the nine added, two things were verified on the head:
- `private` is unset in its package.json.
- A path the diff changes is inside its `files` list. That path is `src/**/*.zod.ts` for spec and `README.md` for the other eight.

Left out, correctly:
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: private, and the diff changes only two comments in it.
- The `src/**` comment in `@object-ui/i18n`'s `zh.ts`: not in `files`, and the package is named anyway because of its README.
- `packages/spec/PLUGIN_STANDARDS.md` and `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md`: not shipped, and their packages are named for other files.

The list is exactly the set of packages that publish a changed byte. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- Deviation 1 (two pushes, no force-with-lease) is the rule-abiding choice. Answered.
- Deviation 2: the PR body still lists the error-catalog and i18n README rows under "taken". Should-fix for the seat on ACCEPT: move both rows to "Kept, by name" and name each pin.
- `out_of_scope_findings`: `implementation-status.mdx` still says "14 lifecycle events" and is left for a docs-only PR. That is the right disposition under AGENTS.md's RELEASE-OWNED row. Answered. First-round item 3 is closed by the revert.
- First-round items:
  - Items 1, 2 and 4 land in `b5dfb180`.
  - Item 3 is closed by the revert.
  - Item 5 is acknowledged.
  - Item 6 (optional) was not taken, which the ratchet permits.

### ④ Design judgment

This section covers only the delta in the `hits` files.

- **skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md**
  - L85 to L87: the three numbers are gone. The pointers to `ComponentMeta` (`base.ts`) and to `RegistryComponentMetaExtras` stay, and the five extras names match the type on the head. Holds. Nit: "The keys in total:" is stilted residue of the deletion.
  - L101 to L102: "The writable keys" are followed by six names, which match the non-`never` keys of `ComponentInput` on the head. Holds.
- **skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md** L25: "the driver passthrough keys", followed by the six names. Holds.
- Re-sweep of all nine `hits` files for a number before an inventory noun found two candidates, and neither is the card's class:
  - "Three renderer-side facts" (schema-expressions.md L324) counts its own three-item list, which is a named kept class.
  - The `>= 3 packages` comment in `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` L860 predates this PR and is not an inventory count.

Outside `hits`, read but not reviewed:
- `error-catalog.mdx` L7 restores the pinned phrase in exactly the shape the test's regex reads. The unpinned "9 error categories" stays deleted.
- `ui/packages/i18n/README.md` L1 to L10 are byte-identical to `main`.
- `content/docs/capabilities/index.mdx` drops its two counts.
- Nothing else moved.

Check-runs on `de4e5cca` at the reviewer's read: no failure. The Test Core and Test UI shards had not reported yet. The seat reads them before ACCEPT.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · #27522 · head `de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f` · 2026-10-29T12:47Z

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删掉没有门禁核对的手写清单计数，比如「49 field types」「8 lifecycle events」「26 built-in metadata types」「38 chart types」。范围是卡片清单表的各行，加上扩扫到的 skills、docs、examples、各包 README 和代码注释里的同类计数，共 40 个文件、+97/−83。枚举出来的名字都保留。`packages/metadata/README.md` 里那张错误的类型表（列着 `trigger`、`validation` 等不存在的类型）换成一句话，指向 `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`。
- 为什么改：这些数字没有门禁对着目录核对，清单一动就错。例如 showcase 写 38 种图表，spec 只有 20 种；README 写 26 种元数据类型，spec 有 31 种。错的数字比没有数字更误导人类读者和 AI 作者。
- **与 PR 描述不一致的两处（以本条为准）：** 卡片清单里有两行其实被测试锁定，按卡片规则「有门禁锁定的计数保留」，已经恢复。
  - `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` 的「**56 error codes reachable on the wire**」，由 `packages/spec/src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts` 锁定。
  - `ui/packages/i18n/README.md` L3、L7 的「10 built-in locales」，由 `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/readme-locale-count-7989.test.ts` 锁定。

  PR 描述里这两行仍写着已删，那是首个提交时的说法。按规程，PR 描述只在创建时写一次。
- 风险与回滚：这是纯文档改动，范围是 README、changeset 和几处代码注释（`packages/spec` 一行 `//` 注释，`ui/` 三个文件的注释），不改任何行为。changeset 是 patch，列出 10 个会发出改动字节的公开包。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/README.md`，`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` 里「Why so few?」那条说明，`skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` L85–L102。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，应该 exit 0，`ratcheted (authored) 207834 / 217474`。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR。它改了 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H。契约复核 PASS 在案：首轮记录 6496355366（`93c9b71f`），增量记录 6496637851（`Head-sha: de4e5ccabb981868b62389693e16af8c24e96e5f`）。批准后由本席落地。

席位意见：首轮复核提出的 should-fix 都已落实；增量复核没有 must-fix。剩下两条小瑕疵不影响合并，原样留着：plugin-development.md L85 的「The keys in total:」读着别扭；`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` 多了 1 个字节，token 数不变。

### 席位核对

1. **Shape**: 40 files, +97/−83, all in the claimed surface (claim 6495656923) plus the wider re-sweep the card asks for, each site named in the PR body. Tier H (`skills/**`); the `domain:devx` / `server` / `spec` / `ui` files enter through triage 6495060086's cross-domain path (one PR, claimed by this lane).
2. **Premise check**:
   - The reviewer re-read every deleted count against its inventory source on the head: `HookEvent`, `ComponentMeta` / `RegistryComponentMetaExtras` / `ComponentInput`, `MetadataTypeSchema`, `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`, the wire face.
   - The skills ratchet is deletion-only: lines unchanged in every touched file, authored bundle 207857 → 207834 tokens.
3. **Gate check-runs** on `de4e5cca`: 58 success, 7 skipped, none failed. `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 27542`: OK, all 7 skips in main's roster. Mergeable `clean`.
4. **Accepted deviations**:
   - The two gate-pinned rows are restored. That is the card's rule; the first head's `Test Core (2/8)` and `Test UI (14/16)` reds were those pins.
   - The PR body is stale on those two rows; this comment carries the correct reading. The relay refuses a body `issue_patch` whose first line is the attribution marker, and os-dev.md writes the body once.
   - `readme-locale-count-7989.test.ts` was NOT MEASURED locally (unbuilt closure); CI `Test UI` is green.
   - Two pushes, not force-with-lease, because the branch is not `claude/issue-*`.
5. **Out-of-scope dispositions**:
   - (a) `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` "14 lifecycle events": reverted out of this PR because the file is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md); dropped from this PR and left for the next docs-only or release PR.
   - (b) Lowering `CEILINGS` rows to the new readings: dropped; it is optional, and the ratchet permits leaving it.
   - (c) The L85 wording nit and the field-types.md +1 byte nit: dropped; they are cosmetic and not worth a new head.
   - `Skills-docs:` n/a (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
6. **Serial constraint**: open PR #27475 edits `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` at L181 only; this PR touches L9. The regions are disjoint, and GitHub reports `clean` against main now. Whichever PR lands second merges main if the queue asks.
7. **Landing clause**: Tier H, so this goes to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`) via `pr_request_reviewers` with this comment. `needs-user-decision` stays on the PR while it waits. After an APPROVED review with every check green, the seat will:
   - strip the label;
   - run `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable` through the relay;
   - confirm MERGED;
   - close #27522 if `Fixes` does not fire.
